name: Polygon-based CGH generation
definition: A method where the scene is composed of 2D surfaces, each considered a light-emitter whose contribution is propagated to the hologram plane; the final hologram is the sum of all surface contributions.
summary: Polygon-based CGH generation synthesizes holograms by integrating wavefronts over 2D polygonal surfaces, reducing computational complexity compared to point-cloud methods and handling arbitrarily oriented planes unlike layer-based approaches.
